nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 collateral asset address held in custody; target of external token calls.
Immutable Loan contract address authorized to pull collateral.
Constructor initializing collateralAsset and loan immutables from arguments.
Modifier enforcing msg.sender == loan; access-control guard for pull.
External isLoan-gated function transferring collateral asset to dst.
Untrusted caller address checked against loan in the isLoan modifier.
Destination address parameter for the collateral transfer.
Amount parameter for the collateral transfer.
External call collateralAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt) transferring tokens out.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns collateralAsset from the _collateralAsset argument.
Constructor assigns the loan address from the _loan argument.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared to the loan state variable in the isLoan require.
loan state variable is read as the trusted caller identity in the isLoan check.
isLoan modifier gates execution of the pull function body.
Untrusted msg.sender indirectly authorizes pull through the isLoan modifier.
dst parameter is passed as the recipient of the safeTransfer external call.
amt parameter is passed as the value of the safeTransfer external call.
pull executes an external token transfer before completing, enabling reentrancy.
collateralAsset state variable is the target of the external safeTransfer call.
A malicious or hook-enabled collateral token can call back into pull during safeTransfer.

normalization_plan.reason: dst exists only as a pull parameter and flows directly into the function's external transfer.
amt exists only as a pull parameter and flows directly into the function's external transfer.
